name: condIndepSets_iff
statement: Set (Set Ω)) (hs1 : ∀ s ∈ s1, MeasurableSet s) (hs2 : ∀ s ∈ s2, MeasurableSet s) (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : CondIndepSets m' hm' s1 s2 μ ↔ ∀ (t1 t2 : Set Ω) (_ : t1 ∈ s1) (_ : t2 ∈ s2), (μ⟦t1 ∩ t2 | m'⟧) =ᵐ[μ] (μ⟦t1 | m'⟧) * (μ⟦t2 | m'⟧)

name: condIndepFun_iff_condDistrib_prod_ae_eq_prodMkRight
statement: Type*} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} {mβ : MeasurableSpace β} {mβ' : MeasurableSpace β'} [StandardBorelSpace β] [Nonempty β] [StandardBorelSpace β'] [Nonempty β'] (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g) {k : Ω → γ} (hk : Measurable k) : g ⟂ᵢ[k, hk; μ] f ↔ condDistrib f (fun ω ↦ (k ω, g ω)) μ =ᵐ[μ.map (fun ω ↦ (k ω, g ω))] (condDistrib f k μ).prodMkRight _
